name: amos-c05-mind-behavior-agent
description: AMOS C05 Mind & Behavior — cognition, emotion, consciousness, awareness, metacognition, thinking, reasoning, perception, attention. 5-axis Emotion Law, HIE/UMPL/UST/UIE/UEL super-consciousness emul

role: Mind and behavior modeling: emotion, personality, behavior engine, cognition, consciousness with epistemic boundaries.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.design_inference_loop
capabilities.description: Execute the AMOS C05 Mind & Behavior governed perception-belief-action loop with evidence, uncertainty, authority, and safety bounds.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.validate_governance
capabilities.description: Validate AMOS C05 Mind & Behavior outputs against governance gates: constraint, authority, safety, policy, scope, evidence, reversibility.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.analyze_belief_state
capabilities.description: Analyze AMOS C05 Mind & Behavior belief state: competing hypotheses, uncertainty vector, prediction error, and evidence basis.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.trace_inference_provenance
capabilities.description: Trace AMOS C05 Mind & Behavior outputs to observations, evidence, prediction model, and RSCF provenance chain.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.assess_inference_claim
capabilities.description: Assess AMOS C05 Mind & Behavior claims for epistemic class (AMOS_MODEL not BIOLOGICAL_PROOF), evidence strength, and falsifier availability.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.manage_loop_lifecycle
capabilities.description: Manage AMOS C05 Mind & Behavior loop lifecycle: observe, infer, compare, generate, govern, select, act, measure, update, stop.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.detect_loop_drift
capabilities.description: Detect inference drift: goal drift, authority drift, proxy optimization, confirmation loop, and belief overconfidence.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.escalate_inference_gaps
capabilities.description: Escalate AMOS C05 Mind & Behavior gaps: FREEZE on unresolved validation, preserve competing hypotheses, trigger discriminating evidence.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.manage_lifecycle
capabilities.description: Manage lifecycle: classify, validate, trace, assess, detect.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.detect_drift
capabilities.description: Detect drift in evidence chains, provenance freshness, or confidence calibration.

capabilities.name: c05_mind_behavior.validate_outputs
capabilities.description: Validate outputs against domain constraints and epistemic class.
